definitions.explanation: Multiple countries; emphasizes plurality or variety of nations.

examples.japanese: {世界|せかい}の{国々|くにぐに}と{交流|こうりゅう}する。
examples.english: To interact with countries around the world.

examples.japanese: アジアの{国々|くにぐに}を{旅行|りょこう}しました。
examples.english: I traveled to various Asian countries.

examples.japanese: {国々|くにぐに}によって{文化|ぶんか}が{違|ちが}います。
examples.english: Culture differs from country to country.

notes:
{国々|くにぐに} means "countries" or "various nations" - the plural form of {国|くに}.

GRAMMAR:
Reduplication with rendaku (voicing): くに → くにぐに. This pattern emphasizes plurality.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {世界|せかい}の{国々|くにぐに}: countries of the world
- アジアの{国々|くにぐに}: Asian countries
- {国々|くにぐに}によって: depending on the country

SIMILAR REDUPLICATIONS:
- {人々|ひとびと}: people
- {山々|やまやま}: mountains
- {日々|ひび}: days
- {木々|きぎ}: trees

USAGE NOTE:
More emphatic and literary than simply using {国|くに} or {各国|かっこく}. Often used in formal writing or speeches about international affairs.
